accuracy.scope: Exact full native references and original-source per-pixel accuracy/quiet-motion metrics. RGB MSE is an image-model diagnostic, not a photographic/semantic quality percentage.

deterministic_cost_scope: Independent non-streaming Z80 core, 256-byte output quotas; excludes IRQ/ULA/paging/physical disk.

startup_and_playback_timing.includes: all elapsed CPU/ROM/disk/IRQ/ULA time from PLAYER entry to finished; excludes BASIC loading PLAYER and human disk changes

actual_disk_timing.disk_latency_note: Fuse call intervals combine ROM execution, physical emulation, IRQs and contention; no artificial separation

scope: Complete accuracy/compression improvement for the user-selected line-drawing style. No claim of global, photographic, semantic or maximum-duration optimality.
